blocks.task_summary: Find the x-coordinates a and b (a < b) of the intersection points of f(x) = 1 − x² and g(x) = e^(2x) on the domain −1 ≤ x ≤ 0.
method_path: Use GDC to solve for x on [−1, 0]

evidence.basis: attempts to find an intersection point (M1); a = −0.916562... or −0.917, b = 0 A1A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the area of the region enclosed by the graphs of f(x) = 1 − x² and g(x) = e^(2x) between x = a and x = b.
method_path: Set up definite integral ∫[a, b] (f(x) − g(x)) dx = ∫[a, 0] (1 − x² − e^(2x)) dx
Evaluate integral using GDC or analytic methods
accepted_alternatives: For M1: show a graph with the required area shaded instead of attempting the integral

evidence.basis: EITHER attempts to form the required integral involving subtraction (M1) OR shows a graph with the required area shaded (M1); THEN ∫ from a to b (f(x)−g(x))dx = ∫ from −0.916562... to 0 (1−x²−e^(2x))dx (A1); A = 0.239855... ≈ 0.240 (A1)
